title.narrative: Guatemala: Facilitating and Diversifying Sustainable Exports and Investments through enhanced digitalisation, sustainability and inclusiveness

description.narrative:
Strengthen Guatemalan institutional capacities and digitalise services of the Ministry of Economy (MINECO), and other public institutions for a more conducive investment and business environment for MSMEs and cooperatives. This will be achieved by focusing on the macro level, providing institutional support and capacity building to MINECO and other relevant public institutions in their process of digitalisation of services provided to MSMEs. Improve the competitiveness of MSMEs and cooperatives in the home textiles and clothing sectors through better access to finance, digitalisation, innovation and new economic models based on circularity and greening.

The project will support the Global Gateway Investment Agenda for Guatemala in the following areas: Digital transformation, digital skills and facilitating trade and investment while strengthening the pharmaceutical sector supply chain

General Objective (Impact): Contribute to inclusive economic development in Guatemala through trade and investment promotion and facilitation with the European Union and regional markets.

Specific Objective (SO) 1: Improved access, transparency, and delivery of MINECO services for trade, investment and MSMES development in Guatemala through digitalisation and interoperability

Specific Objective (SO) 2 Increased competitiveness of the Guatemalan pharmaceutical and clothing industries for the regional and European market

title.narrative: Number of MINECOs dependencies equipped to deliver or track its support services for MSMEs

description.narrative: This indicator assesses the readiness and capability of MINECOs Directorate for MSMEs development to provide support services for micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) by capturing the following aspects:Number of MINECOs Dependencies: This refers only to the Directorate for MSMEs developmentEquipped: This indicates that the Directorate for MSMEs development has the necessary resources, tools, or technology to effectively deliver services or track their performance. This involves training staff, implementing digital systems.Deliver or Track Support Services:Deliver: Refers to the ability to provide services directly to MSMEs, such as advisory services, financial assistance, or capacitybuilding programs.Track: Involves the capability to monitor and assess the effectiveness of the services provided, ensuring that they meet the needs of MSMEs and can be improved over time.

title.narrative: Number of new European pharmaceutical companies expressing interest in/seeking advocacy support in Guatemala

description.narrative: This indicator measures the level of interest and engagement from European pharmaceutical companies regarding investment opportunities in Guatemala by capturing the following aspects: Number of New European Pharmaceutical Companies: This refers specifically to pharmaceutical firms based in Europe that are newly considering or pursuing opportunities in Guatemala. The focus on new companies emphasizes recent interest, distinguishing it from existing or previously engaged firms.Expressing Interest: This indicates that these companies have shown a willingness or desire to explore investment options in Guatemala. This interest could be manifested through inquiries, meetings, market research, or other forms of communication indicating their intent to enter the market.Seeking Advocacy Support: This aspect highlights that these companies are looking for assistance or representation, potentially from government agencies, trade organizations, or investment promotion bodies. Advocacy support may involve navigating regulatory frameworks, understanding local market conditions, or receiving help with investment incentives.

title.narrative: 2.2. Enhanced capacity of Guatemalan clothing manufacturers to reduce their environmental footprint and seize new and sustainable trade opportunities in the regional and European Union market

description.narrative: 2.2. Enhanced capacity of Guatemalan clothing manufacturers to reduce their environmental footprint and seize new and sustainable trade opportunities in the regional and European Union market

title.narrative: Number of Guatemalan clothing manufacturers adopting environmentally friendly production methods, such as use of organic materials, ecofriendly dyes, and energyefficient manufacturing processes.

description.narrative: The indicator captures the adoption of sustainable and ecofriendly practices by Guatemalan clothing manufacturers including among others: Use of Organic Materials: Clothing manufacturers are choosing to source and use raw materials that are grown without synthetic pesticides, fertilizers, or other harmful chemicals. Organic cotton, hemp, or other sustainable fabrics would fall under this category.Ecofriendly Dyes: Manufacturers are shifting from traditional synthetic dyes, which often contain harmful chemicals, to more sustainable alternatives. Ecofriendly dyes may include plantbased dyes or lowimpact dyes that are less toxic and less polluting.Energyefficient Manufacturing Processes: This involves the implementation of technologies or practices that reduce energy consumption during production. For example, using renewable energy sources, optimizing machinery for efficiency, or reducing waste in the production process.

title.narrative: Number of REI textiles and clothing smallscale businesses having transacted new businesses via digital channels.

description.narrative: This indicator measures how smallscale textiles and clothing businesses are leveraging digital channels to expand their market reach capturing the following elements:Number of REI Textiles and Clothing SmallScale Businesses: This specifically refers to smallscale enterprises involved in the textiles and clothing sector, potentially including those engaged in producing, manufacturing, or selling related products.Transacted New Businesses: This indicates that these businesses have successfully engaged in new transactions, which could involve selling products, securing new customers, or entering into new contracts. The focus on new businesses emphasizes recent growth or expansion efforts.Via Digital Channels: This specifies that the transactions have occurred through online platforms or digital means, such as ecommerce websites, social media, mobile apps, or other digital communication tools. This highlights the role of technology in facilitating business operations.

title.narrative: Number of clothing manufacturers having transacted new businesses with European and Central American business partners

description.narrative: This indicator measures the level of international business engagement among clothing manufacturers by capturing the following elements:Number of Clothing Manufacturers: This refers specifically to manufacturers in the clothing sector, providing a focused view of industry performance.Transacted New Businesses: The term transacted indicates that these manufacturers have successfully engaged in new business dealings, which may include exporting goods, forming partnerships, or securing contracts.
